notes.title: Prime Directive Demo Play Through Event
notes.notes:
Welcome to the mysterious world of Prime Directive. Marty has crashed onto an alien world and must now escape!

Join the developer as he explores the demo for Prime Directive. Look behind the curtain at some of the challenges and triumphs that went into the titles development.
